First, let's sketch the graph of $y=\operatorname{arcsin}⁡(\frac{x+1}{2}):$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13996467/assets/922781004fc917f3a62726689c43f0226c680de58f446b741f9994c4c65134e3.png)

The domain of $\operatorname{arcsin}⁡(\frac{x+1}{2})$ is $x\in [-3,1].$ This means that $\operatorname{arcsin}⁡(\frac{x+1}{2})$ is undefined outside this interval.

Therefore, ${lim}_{x\to \,\infty }8\operatorname{arcsin}⁡(\frac{x+1}{2})$ is undefined.
